summary: Iteration 8 retest of Prompt 3 Student Master after db.py index fix + student_routes regex escape. Ran full pytest suite (89 tests). 88/89 PASSED (98.9%). 3 of 4 previously failing tests now PASS (test_12_duplicate_force_bypasses, test_20_list_pagination_and_search, test_91_idempotent_conversion_second_call). test_90_shared_guardian_across_siblings STILL FAILS — but for a different reason than iteration 7. The index bug is confirmed fixed; the remaining failure is a business-logic gap in CRM leads duplicate detection that blocks sibling lead creation.

critical.issue: test_90_shared_guardian_across_siblings fails at the 2nd sibling's lead creation with 409 duplicate_lead. Root cause: create_lead() in crm_routes.py (lines 144-156) treats a shared parent_mobile as a duplicate, so siblings sharing a parent cannot both be admitted via the full pipeline (lead→app→convert). This blocks the intended 'shared guardian across siblings' feature. The iteration 7 db.py/regex fix did NOT touch this path. Options: (a) exclude shared-parent-mobile-only matches from duplicate detection when student_first/last/dob differ, or (b) update the test helper _admit() to pass force=true on subsequent siblings. Either is a business-logic decision for main agent.

action_items: Decide: relax CRM lead duplicate detection so a shared parent_mobile alone (without matching student name+dob) does not trigger 409, OR update test_90 _admit() helper to pass force=true on 2nd sibling lead creation. The former better matches the design intent of the 'shared guardian across siblings' feature.
critical_code_review_comments: crm_routes.py create_lead(): duplicate detection treats parent_mobile alone as a duplicate — conflicts with legitimate sibling admissions. Consider requiring both parent_mobile + (matching student name/dob) or making parent_mobile+student_dob the composite key.
Index fix in db.py verified working — no student-level duplicate_admission errors observed in any test.
seed_data_creation: None — tests self-seed via existing fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 89-test full suite is stable. The lone remaining failure test_90_shared_guardian_across_siblings occurs at the CRM lead creation step (2nd sibling), NOT at student index level — index fix from iteration 8 works. Failure signature: 409 {code: duplicate_lead} at line 285 of test_student_master.py. Fix must be in crm_routes.py create_lead() duplicate detection logic OR in test helper _admit().
rca of the issue: In crm_routes.py:145-154, create_lead() OR-matches on parent_mobile, parent_email, and (student_first/last + dob). For siblings sharing a parent_mobile, the OR clause hits the parent_mobile branch and returns 409 duplicate_lead before the student can be created. The iteration 8 changes (index in db.py, regex escape in student_routes.py) do not touch this path. Reproduction: sibling1 leads/admit succeeds; sibling2 with same parent_mobile fails at POST /api/school/crm/leads with 409. Mitigation: either send force=true on subsequent siblings in the test helper, or change duplicate detection to require parent_mobile + student identity match together.
